FAQ.SUBTITLE: Clear answers on how we collaborate, the level of ownership we assume, and the way we manage measurable outcomes.
FAQ.TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions

Q1.A: Our managed service can include service framing, governance, operational coordination, IBM Maximo expertise, and performance follow-up. The exact scope is tailored to your priorities, maturity, and desired level of delegation.
Q1.Q: What does your managed service actually cover?

Q2.A: We start with a framing workshop to understand your operating context, organizational model, rhythm, and expected outcomes. That allows us to recommend the most relevant service level and a transition path if your needs evolve.
Q2.Q: How do you determine the right service level for our organization?

Q3.A: We establish simple governance: recurring check-ins, clear ownership, shared metrics, and agreed communication channels. Our experts operate as an extension of your teams without adding unnecessary overhead.
Q3.Q: How do you work with our internal teams?

Q4.A: Yes. We support both existing environments and transformation programs. Our role can focus on stabilizing operations, evolving practices, and securing services that are already live.
Q4.Q: Can you support an IBM Maximo environment that is already in place?

Q5.A: Together we define the right indicators: service availability, delivery quality, commitment tracking, adoption, reliability, and process efficiency. These metrics feed steering committees and continuous improvement actions.
Q5.Q: How do you measure performance over time?
